Container.Name: Excaliself
Container.Overview:
Excaliself is a self-hosted Excalidraw for teams: the Excalidraw editor with accounts, live collaboration, a team space, folders, search, and share links. Every drawing is stored in PostgreSQL.
Before you install: - Install a PostgreSQL container, for example postgresql17 from Community Applications. Set its POSTGRES_USER and POSTGRES_DB to excaliself, and its POSTGRES_PASSWORD to the output of: openssl rand -hex 24 - Generate the auth secret with: openssl rand -base64 32
Then open the WebUI. The first account you create is the admin.
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL database, for example the postgresql17 container from Community Applications.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: The address you open Excaliself at, with the port, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000 or https://draw.example.com. Sign-in refuses pages from any other address.

Config.Name: Other URLs
Config.Description: Optional. Other addresses you also open Excaliself at, separated by commas, for example http://tower.local:3000

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: postgresql://excaliself:PASSWORD@SERVER-IP:5432/excaliself, with the PostgreSQL container's password and your server's IP.

Config.Name: Auth secret
Config.Description: At least 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32
